statement: RunPod lists an on-demand Secure Cloud rate of $3.29 per GPU-hour for the H100 SXM, captured 2026-08-22 with no prior-period baseline.
why: Per-GPU rental rates are the visible reference cost of renting an accelerator, but a single capture with no baseline shows a level, not a direction.

impact.mechanism: Listed per-GPU hourly rates set the reference cost of accelerator capacity for renters; with no baseline this is a static level and a display overlay only.

evidence.excerpt: H100 SXM - Community rate absent; Secure '$3.29/hr'.
All listed pricing represents per-hour on-demand rates.

confidence.basis: Single vendor pricing page capture, secondary tier; cheaper Community Cloud rates did not render, so only the Secure Cloud tier is visible.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 6.79 -> 3.29 (tol 1%); sources: RunPod
